name: Amazon SQS
description: Bounded SQS queue and message operations with SigV4, explicit receipt acknowledgements and guarded writes.

permissions.description: HTTPS only to configured SQS endpoint; SigV4 credentials from named secrets. Optional session token via configured reference. Every effect, including receive, requires explicit confirmation and zero retries. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: List Queues (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
ListQueues: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.ListQueues, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly.  All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_ListQueues.html

definitions.name: Get Queue Url (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GetQueueUrl: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.GetQueueUrl, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly.  All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_GetQueueUrl.html

definitions.name: Get Queue Attributes (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GetQueueAttributes: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.GetQueueAttributes, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly.  All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_GetQueueAttributes.html

definitions.name: List Queue Tags (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
ListQueueTags: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.ListQueueTags, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly.  All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_ListQueueTags.html

definitions.name: Tag Queue (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
TagQueue: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.TagQueue, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=TAG_QUEUE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_TagQueue.html

definitions.name: Untag Queue (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
UntagQueue: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.UntagQueue, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=UNTAG_QUEUE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_UntagQueue.html

definitions.name: Send Message (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
SendMessage: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.SendMessage, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SEND_MESSAGE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_SendMessage.html

definitions.name: Send Message Batch (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
SendMessageBatch: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.SendMessageBatch, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SEND_MESSAGE_BATCH. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_SendMessageBatch.html

definitions.name: Receive Message (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
ReceiveMessage: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.ReceiveMessage, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=RECEIVE_MESSAGE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_ReceiveMessage.html

DeleteMessage: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.DeleteMessage, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=DELETE_MESSAGE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteMessage.html

definitions.name: Create Queue (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
CreateQueue: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.CreateQueue, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=CREATE_QUEUE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_CreateQueue.html

SetQueueAttributes: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.SetQueueAttributes, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SET_QUEUE_ATTRIBUTES. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_SetQueueAttributes.html

definitions.name: Purge Queue (SQS) (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PurgeQueue: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.PurgeQueue, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=PURGE_QUEUE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_PurgeQueue.html

QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=REMOVE_PERMISSION. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. definitions.name: SQS Message Received (Relay) Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by SQS Message Received (Relay).
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for SQS Message Received (Relay). This trigger accepts the canonical version-1 amazon-sqs envelope only; it does not authenticate or decode native provider requests. Required exact provider verification: Deploy an IAM-authorized bounded SQS consumer using the configured queue ARN and expected AWS account; never accept arbitrary HTTP payloads as SQS messages. Mapping: Emit one message.received envelope per message, with queue ARN/name, MessageId, exact UTF-8 Body bytes encoded as base64, and ApproximateReceiveCount (use 1 if absent). Relay owns ReceiveMessage, visibility extension, redelivery, dead-letter handling and DeleteMessage. Canonical eventType values: message.received. Required envelope: version=1, provider=amazon-sqs, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. Receiving changes visibility; no ONF queue polling or deletion is performed. The relay must durably retain accepted work before deleting a provider message. HTTP 202 does not prove downstream success. Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html

ingressRequirements.name: Amazon SQS message relay
ingressRequirements.description: Manual prerequisite: separately maintained exact provider authentication/normalization relay. This release only accepts header-authenticated canonical envelopes from that relay.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.
Deploy an IAM-authorized bounded SQS consumer using the configured queue ARN and expected AWS account; never accept arbitrary HTTP payloads as SQS messages.

Emit one message.received envelope per message, with queue ARN/name, MessageId, exact UTF-8 Body bytes encoded as base64, and ApproximateReceiveCount (use 1 if absent). Relay owns ReceiveMessage, visibility extension, redelivery, dead-letter handling and DeleteMessage.

Implement the exact canonical version-1 envelope and typed resource schemas documented by each selected trigger; forward one event per POST. Normalize account identity from the authorized provider connection, never from an untrusted request.

Persist one stable delivery ID per logical event across relay retries. Fanout IDs must include distinct native entity/event/status identity (or a persisted record ID); reusing a batch delivery ID or message ID across different statuses drops events. Authorize account/resources; bound payloads to 64 KiB and limit rate.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-events"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.

network.purpose: Provider HTTPS callbacks reach the independently deployed relay; ONF uses its existing HTTPS publication.
